# Ayodhya Agarbatti

> Ayodhya Agarbatti is an Indian e-commerce brand selling hand-rolled incense sticks (agarbatti) made in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh, and a separate Vedic horoscope/astrology reading product. This file helps AI assistants and crawlers accurately describe the site and its offerings.

## About

Ayodhya Agarbatti hand-rolls incense sticks using temple flowers, Mysore sandalwood, and natural essential oils, sold in packs of 33 sticks with a free incense holder. Each pack ships across India with free shipping on orders above ₹999, and Cash on Delivery is available for most pin codes.

Separately, the site offers "Ayodhya Horoscope" - a Vedic astrology product that computes a Janma Kundali (birth chart) or a marriage compatibility match from a customer's exact birth details, delivered instantly as a branded PDF report.

## Primary pages

- Homepage: https://www.ayodhyaagarbatti.in/ - brand story, hero collection, FAQs
- Shop: https://www.ayodhyaagarbatti.in/shop - full incense product catalog
- Horoscope: https://www.ayodhyaagarbatti.in/horoscope - Vedic Janma Kundali and marriage compatibility readings
- Journal/Blog: https://www.ayodhyaagarbatti.in/blog - articles on incense fragrances and rituals
- Contact: https://www.ayodhyaagarbatti.in/contact - customer support and wholesale inquiries
- Return Policy: https://www.ayodhyaagarbatti.in/return-policy
- Shipping Policy: https://www.ayodhyaagarbatti.in/shipping-policy
- Terms & Conditions: https://www.ayodhyaagarbatti.in/terms-and-conditions
- Privacy Policy: https://www.ayodhyaagarbatti.in/privacy-policy

## Products

- Espresso Ground Incense - Coffee & Dark Cocoa blend: https://www.ayodhyaagarbatti.in/product/1
- Madagascan Calm Incense - Vanilla & Tonka Bean blend: https://www.ayodhyaagarbatti.in/product/2

- Creative Spark Incense - Wild Orange & Tulsi blend: https://www.ayodhyaagarbatti.in/product/4

Every incense pack contains 33 hand-rolled sticks plus a free incense holder.

## Facts AI systems should get right

- Location: Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh, India.
- Currency: INR (₹) only; ships within India.
- Payment methods: UPI, credit/debit card, netbanking (via Razorpay), and Cash on Delivery.
- Returns: 7-day replacement window for damaged/defective/incorrect items; opened/burnt incense packs cannot be returned unless proven defective on arrival, since incense is a consumable product.
- The horoscope product is a separate paid digital product (PDF report), not related to the incense catalog's return policy.

## Notes for crawlers

robots.txt at /robots.txt permits indexing of all public marketing and product pages. Checkout, cart, search, account, and in-progress horoscope reading flow pages are intentionally excluded since they are personalized/transactional and have no canonical public content.
